description: [FREE: 25 calls/day, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402] For a Uniswap-V2-style pool, computes the exact output of a swap (the router's integer formula), the total cost versus the spot price including the fee, and the part due to trade size alone, in basis points. Inputs are reserves and amounts in base units. Does not know any pool: you supply the reserves.
name: swap_price_impact
title: Constant-product swap output and price impact
